convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in MT5 functions (iHigh, iLow, iTime) and standard Trade/PositionInfo library classes. Simple breakout entry/exit logic with fixed lot sizing. No custom indicators or external trading logic libraries.

other_exits: SL/TP are set/modified on every tick for positions that lack them or have incorrect values - the EA continuously enforces correct SL/TP on open positions

position_sizing.conditional_logic: Lot size is rounded down to nearest valid volume step via stepvol*(int)(iLots/stepvol); set to 0 if below SYMBOL_VOLUME_MIN

custom_logic_notes: Breakout levels reset to 0 after a trade is triggered (level_up=0 after buy, level_dw=0 after sell), preventing re-entry on the same level until a new bar forms and updates the levels. SL/TP enforcement loop runs every tick, modifying any position belonging to this EA that doesn't have the correct SL/TP values. The new_bar_guard only controls level updates - entry signals are checked every tick using intrabar prices against the previous bar's high/low.
python_conversion_notes: Straightforward breakout strategy. Convert iHigh/iLow[1] to previous bar high/low lookups. The level reset after trade execution (level_up=0 / level_dw=0) must be preserved to prevent duplicate entries. The SL/TP enforcement loop that runs every tick needs to be replicated as a position management step. Note: SL/TP use _Point multiplier without 5-digit adjustment - verify target platform uses same pip definition. The NewBar() function uses static datetime comparison - replicate with a last_bar_time tracker. Position gate is 'any' meaning multiple positions can stack if breakout persists before level reset.
